job: Pick one of two to five options that change what you see here.
purpose: A radio group drawn as a track with a white thumb that slides to the chosen option: audience, state filter, theme. Items may be buttons with role="radio", toggle buttons with aria-pressed, links, or labels around native radios in a form (so it posts). A track narrower than its options scrolls sideways. fd:change carries the item's data-value.
useWhen: Two to five mutually exclusive options change the view in place: All, Mine, Archived.
A mode or theme is set, and each option is short.
A form needs a choice of two to four short options and should post (labels around radios).

avoidWhen.when: There are more than five options, or an option goes to another page.
The options are categories to browse.
A setting is on or off.

states.name: selected
states.how: aria-checked="true", aria-pressed="true" or aria-current on the item

states.name: empty
states.how: data-empty on the thumb when nothing is selected

variants.useWhen: In a toolbar or a dense row.
Each item is an icon with an aria-label.
Items share the row equally; keep labels short.
The selected icon takes the accent colour.
Several labelled groups share one track.

parts.role: The sliding white thumb; added by nav.js.
A labelled group of items in the grouped variant.
A count after an item label.

keyboard.does: Move the selection to the next or previous option (radio mode).
Select the first or last option.
